newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed in AM trade, August dominates.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed in AM trade, August dominates.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mixed in morning trading, with most of the activity on August.
By 1015 GMT August was $1.20 lower at $320.0 on 1,264 lots of a total 1,563 done. October was 20 cents higher at $314.90 on 249 lots.
One trader noted the narrowing of the August/October spread, which had rallied out to $6.00 on Thursday. It was now offered at $5.00, he said.
There was still talk of fund shorts in the market, he said. London's main problem remained a lack of fundamental news.
In New York on Thursday, benchmark October closed a thinly traded session slightly lower after failing to hold early gains. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
